blockers: The idle strip does not demonstrate three independently readable breathing rhythms; the poses remain nearly static and the frame-to-frame changes are too subtle at native scale.

Signature gestures do not expand the silhouettes decisively enough at 1x. Celina's sword gesture remains a thin accessory line, while Agnes's and The Gambler's gestures mostly read as minor arm shifts.
Facial structure is below professional readability at the 128px contract. All three faces collapse into small pale discs with insufficient eyes, hairline, and expression separation.
The cast hierarchy is technically within the height budget, but Celina and The Gambler occupy nearly the same vertical scale, weakening the intended visual ranking.
The animation sheets do not provide convincing anticipation, overshoot, or settle. They look like pose substitutions rather than authored motion with distinct physical timing.
high_value_changes: Redesign each idle cycle around a different center of mass: Celina should breathe through the ribcage and sword wrist, Agnes through a delayed torso compression with shoulder weight, and The Gambler through a buoyant torso lift followed by a loose hat and knee settle.

Push gesture silhouettes outward by several pixels at native resolution. Give Celina a clearer fencing extension, Agnes a broad gauntlet-led brace or punch preparation, and The Gambler a large asymmetrical flourish with hat or coat-tail countershape.
Increase facial value separation and simplify each face into a deliberate 1x graphic: Celina's sharp pale profile, Agnes's heavier brow and jaw, and The Gambler's mask-like theatrical expression.

Establish a stronger scale hierarchy instead of relying only on body width. Keep Agnes shortest and widest, make Celina visibly tallest and narrowest, and give The Gambler a slightly shorter, more exaggerated hat-and-leg silhouette.

Re-time locomotion with visible weight transfer. Agnes needs a delayed pelvis and foot plant, Celina needs a clean leading-foot fencing march, and The Gambler needs a lateral hip drift with a late, slippery recovery.
optional_notes: The three palette families are directionally independent, but Celina's navy and The Gambler's dark green both lose separation against the dark sheet background without stronger local highlights.

Agnes is the clearest static silhouette because the shoulder mass and boots create a stable block. Celina's thin legs and sword create a fragile contour, while The Gambler's V-shaped legs are distinctive but risk reading as a generic standing flourish.

The fixed bottom anchor appears broadly consistent in the lineup, but the thin feet and dark boot values make small vertical shifts difficult to diagnose. Add an explicit anchor-difference inspection at 1x.
The supplied sheets are enlarged presentation views; the decisive test remains a 192x192 canvas viewed at native scale with no zoom smoothing.
regressions_from_previous: No prior-round comparison material was supplied, so specific regressions cannot be verified.
Relative to the stated ensemble goals, the current pass still shows unresolved weakness in independent idle timing and 1x gesture expansion.
strongest_improvements: The cast now has a credible broad-versus-slender-versus-diagonal silhouette strategy.
Agnes's grounded mass and The Gambler's bent-leg posture provide the strongest character separation.
The palette assignments are recognizable and broadly support role differentiation.
The locomotion grid establishes the intended directional personality differences more clearly than the idle strip.
luna_evaluation.single_most_important_next_change: Rebuild the three idle and signature-gesture cycles at native 192x192 resolution so each character has a visibly different center-of-mass rhythm and a silhouette-expanding peak pose that reads instantly at 1x.
